summary: More netapp.ontap modules gained AWS Lambda support, including LDAP, LUN, NFS, qtree, quotas, S3, snapmirror, snapshot, SVM, volume and vserver peer modules.
questions: Do the netapp.ontap S3 modules support AWS Lambda?
Can na_ontap_svm be run via AWS Lambda?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap 14.0.0 Lambda support (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md: AWS Lambda support also added to: `na_ontap_ldap_client`, `na_ontap_local_hosts`, LUN modules (`lun`, `lun_copy`, `lun_map`, `lun_map_reporting_nodes`), `na_ontap_name_mappings`, `na_ontap_name_service_switch`, `na_ontap_nfs`, `na_ontap_qos_policy_group`, `na_ontap_qtree`, `na_ontap_quotas`, `na_ontap_rest_info`, `na_ontap_restit`, S3 modules (buckets, groups, policies, services, users), `na_ontap_snapmirror(_policy)`, `na_ontap_snapshot(_policy)`, `na_ontap_svm`, `na_ontap_volume_autosize`, `na_ontap_volume_clone`, `na_ontap_vserver_peer(_permissions)` and `na_ontap_wait_for_condition`.
